name: smwgraphics-sonic-cd-title-screen
title: Sonic CD - Title Screen
description:
This is the background used in the title screen of Sonic the Hedgehog CD for the Sega Mega-CD.

NOTE: Set H-Scroll to None and V-Scroll to None or Constant.

Updates:
Added clouds. (From Prototype 510)
Removed duplicate and empty space in the ExGFX files.
